The combo parameters (super_stop=-0.15, super_tp1=0.75, runner_target=3.0, level_qty=18, level_stop=-0.12, level_tp1=0.3, trendline_stop=-0.06) aim to capture edge by being extremely selective, only entering on high-conviction signals (as evidenced by the high level_qty and tight trendline_stop).
